items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: they didn't allow Bainan to come into the church

ctx.x: Yeah, this is the second reel of Sylvester Hand. Do you want to get to it? Yes. Okay. Yeah, we were talking while she's gone about how the camp funeral got organized. Well, the main people that helped with all that were Fred and Philly. Right. Yeah, quite.

As far as I know, because I was so much in grief until I didn't know what was going on. All I did, it was so amusing to me to see so many people and to see you and different other you know, that, uh, but, uh, but, uh, they had, uh, see at the funeral, that's the first time, those people that had a band to come into church. Mm-hmm. And if you're a band, they come right on, if, you're a band, they come right on in the church playing. Yeah. Do you understand? Do you understand? Like they usually do. Mm-hmm. And now,…
